**The native build of 1.3.0.** It's the same code as 1.3.0, published so panels on the **Native** channel get it. With `rust` in `/etc/flytower/agent`, every job the system helper does, along with updates and **Go back to**, runs in Rust. It's still off unless you switch it on. 1.4.0 plans to make it the default.

Testing: on a spare VPS, switch Rust on and follow [Testing the Rust agent](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/native-1.3.0-native.1/docs/testing/testing-rust-agent.md).
